summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes opaque obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun standalone runtime (v1.3.13) from oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, then invokes `execFileSync(bunBinary, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], { stdio: 'inherit' })`. The sibling `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB string-array-rotation obfuscated JavaScript bundle (rotator `WV8StW(MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift()))` over a large numeric/string constant array with an alphabet-based decoder), unrelated to the package's stated purpose of a Verdaccio Okta OAuth plugin. Executing the obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded alien runtime causes it to run outside Node-based inspection and `npm audit` on every `npm install` of this package. package.json also claims the repository `github.com/servicetitan/uikit.git` while publishing unscoped as `verdaccio-okta-oauth`, an impersonation shape that targets consumers seeking a ServiceTitan-branded Verdaccio Okta plugin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
